answer_1.quote: Automatic text summarisation can provide significant value in the generation of scientific lay summaries.

answer_2.quote: we report the F1-scores of ROUGE-1, 2, and L. Additionally, we include FKGL and DCRS scores of the generated output

answer_4.quote: we perform an additional human evaluation of our standard BART baseline model using two domain experts.
answer_4.guideline: judges are asked to rate the model output based on three criteria: (1) Comprehensiveness, (2) Layness, (3) Factuality.
